description:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026!

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Role Description

Prediction markets are one of Phantom's top priorities, and the category is still wide open. The interfaces everyone uses today are not the end state. As a Senior Product Manager on the Predictions team, you'll shape what trading on real-world events should feel like, from five-minute crypto markets to live sports, politics, and culture.

You'll start with something most prediction products spend years building: more than 20 million people who already hold and trade their money in Phantom, tokens, perps, and stablecoins in the same app. We're looking for someone with the creativity to use that, the judgment to decide what matters, and the drive to see it through without waiting to be asked.

Responsibilities

  • Define how Phantom wins in a competitive market. Build on our funded user base, crypto infrastructure, and existing trading products to make discovering, funding, and trading predictions simpler and more connected.

  • Own the prediction markets experience end to end, from discovery to payout.

  • Sweat the design details with our designers. Make trading simpler for someone placing a first prediction and more powerful for someone placing their fiftieth of the day.

  • Build a team that stays close to traders. Talk to them every week, read support tickets, and dogfood every build. Turn what you learn into roadmap decisions, and make these habits part of how the team works.

  • Make every trade trustworthy. Own trade execution, position and PnL accuracy, and clear market resolution, so traders can rely on every number on the screen.

  • Own market discovery and retention. Decide which markets we list and feature, how we surface live events, and how personalization, notifications, and social features give traders reasons to return.

  • Make the calls. Decide what to build, what to cut, and when something is ready to ship, often with incomplete information, and own the outcome.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, and our exchange and liquidity partners to ship in a regulated category. Set shared goals and report progress every week, including what isn't working.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years as a full-time Product Manager or founder, including a consumer product you owned end to end and grew through measurable improvements in adoption, retention, or revenue.

  • You trade yourself (prediction markets, perps, crypto, or something more exotic) and have strong opinions about which products do it well. Comfortable reasoning about order books, liquidity, pricing, and settlement.

  • Original product thinking, with a record of turning what you learned from users into something new that people adopted.

  • Strong design sensibility. You can point to work where you made something simpler without taking power away from the people who wanted it.

  • You stay close to users and use AI agents and data to test what you hear, investigate product performance, and measure whether your decisions worked.

  • You pick up problems without being asked and see them through. You know when to gather more evidence and when to make a call.

  • A close collaborator. You can lead engineering, design, legal, and marketing without formal authority, and you're technical enough to work through exchange, onchain, and data integrations in detail.

  • Bonus points if you have:

    • Worked at a prediction market, sportsbook, exchange, or brokerage.

    • Built something on crypto rails that could not have been built without them.

    • Built real-time, live-event, or high-frequency trading products.

Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

 

  • Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

  • Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

  • Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.

Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered

  • Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Wellness stipend

  • Weekly meal stipend

  • Learning & Development stipend

  • Remote / WFH set-up stipend

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
